title: No Longer I
question: What does Paul mean that he lives, yet not he?
blurb: An old life ended and a new one begun. Follow the idea across the letters.

nodes.content: What does Paul mean that he lives, yet not he?

nodes.verseText: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.
For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
